reply_text:
Reading how the live gap chart was built (gaps of 6+ hours between your turns; bar height is agent tokens logged in each gap), so the one-file tool can compute the same thing from anyone's logs.Existing tests pass. Adding tests for the gap arithmetic and token de-duplication, including the bad cases (a repeated Claude reply, a repeated Codex running total, a short gap).Tests pass (9). Now running the rebuilt single file on your last 3 days of real logs to see the chart.The run is going in the background (about 600 MB of logs over 3 days, so several minutes). Once it finishes I'll check the chart and put the updated file on staging and in futon7a.Now only the real 21-hour gap on 26–27 September remains. Fixing "1 gaps" wording, then updating the download on staging and in futon7a.You've pushed futon7a since, including your own edits. Updating just the download file and its checksum there, and doing the same on staging.Gist: The single file now draws the gap chart too. It finds every stretch of 6 hours or more with no turn typed by you, adds up the tokens agents logged during it, and writes the result to `xiaoxiang-report.html` as mirrored bars on a date axis, like the lower panel on the live page. The new file and its checksum are committed in futon7a (883a676) but not pushed. I added half a sentence to the box saying it draws the chart. A sample report from your last 3 days is on staging at `/staging/xiaoxiang-sample-report.html`.

**How it measures**
- **Gaps:** a gap runs between two turns you typed, is at least 6 hours long, and has some agent tokens in it. That's the same 6-hour rule the forensic report behind the live chart used.
- **Claude tokens:** input, cache and output tokens for each reply. A single reply is written over several lines with the same usage, so each reply is counted once.
- **Codex tokens:** the tokens of each model call, with cached input included. Codex repeats identical token events, and these are counted once.
- **Privacy:** the page shows only dates, hours and token counts. It never shows turn text or file paths.

**A bug the real run caught**
- **What happened:** `--days 3` picks log files by when they were last modified. One long Codex session reached back to 11 August, and its tokens produced a false 382-hour gap.
- **The fix:** `--days` now also leaves out turns and tokens from before the window.
- **Result on your last 3 days:** one gap, 26 Sep 16:51 to 27 Sep 13:56 (21 hours, 540 million tokens). The run took 4 minutes.

**One thing specific to your setup:** in your Codex logs, turns relayed through Agency are marked `Origin: unknown`, so they aren't counted as typed by you. That makes your gaps look longer than they were, but people using Claude Code or Codex directly won't hit this.

**Tests:** 14 in the reader file, and all three test files pass. The new tests plant each bad case: a Claude reply written twice, a repeated Codex token event, a gap shorter than 6 hours, and turns from before the window.

**Commits:** futon3c 42e1a1ea, futon7 e533df7, futon7a 883a676. Staging has been rebuilt.
